unit.why: A single anecdote: the rebbe weeps in his covered carriage on the way to Warsaw and explains why by telling an embedded tale about his grandfather the Maggid and the Rebbe of Lizhensk.

stories.start_quote: עוד סיפר לי בי פ"א היה נוסע
stories.end_quote: עד היכן הגיע היראת שמים שלו
stories.summary_en: Travelling to Warsaw, the rebbe has his carriage covered as he passes Grójec and weeps. He explains that his grandfather the holy Maggid once feared he was not on the right path, until the Rebbe of Lizhensk greeted him with regards from the angel Michael, and that if such a man feared, how much more must he.
